title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.03634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. translated_title: WebHarbor：对接真实网站以构建可演化的GUI智能体环境
translated_abstract: GUI网页智能体需要在评估和训练过程中都保持稳定的、真实且可交互的环境。基于真实网站的评估受制于内容变化、访问限制以及登录后工作流覆盖有限等问题，而现有的用于训练的合成环境往往缺乏功能深度和视觉保真度。我们提出WebHarbor，这是一个包含153个可执行且已Docker化的网站环境套件，能够在确定性控制下忠实重建真实网络服务的视觉界面、内容和功能工作流。我们通过任务驱动的人机协作来构建WebHarbor：随着新任务扩展环境的功能范围，环境不断演化，编码智能体负责实现所需的更改，人类贡献者则负责审查视觉保真度、功能正确性和任务有效性。最终形成的套件包含3,518个任务，涵盖多步骤和登录后工作流，而现有（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: WebHarbor通过任务驱动的人机协作，构建了153个忠实还原真实网站的Docker化可执行环境，提供涵盖多步骤和登录后工作流的3,518个任务，为GUI网页智能体提供稳定可控的评估与训练环境。
en_tdlr: WebHarbor provides 153 dockerized, executable website environments faithfully reconstructed from real websites through task-driven human-agent collaboration, offering 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows for stable GUI agent evaluation and training.
